components.prompt_core: dark ornate immortal hall interior, tall lacquered pillars fading into ink-wash haze, faint crimson brazier glow, drifting embers and talisman papers
brooding swordsman seen in left profile, tattered fur-lined dark hanfu, sheathed dao blade rising over his shoulder, huge blood-red moon behind barren branches, crimson aura
white-haired woman reading an ornate glowing tome, decorated gourd vessel at her waist, paper talismans drifting through crimson haze, crescent moon charm behind her

handsome masculine male cultivator, strong jaw, broad shoulders, dark neck tattoos, gazing upward at a glowing spirit moth on his fingertip, spectral serpent-dragon coiling through crimson smoke above, ornate dark collar

woman in profile before a tall ornate bronze mirror, the mirror clearly showing a detailed reflection of her face gazing back, red spider lilies blooming at the mirror base, floral hair ornaments, crimson glow
